audit.summary: Three Major issues: false local sphere-product theorem, incorrect third fundamental form, and incompatible Weyl/Bach normalization. Four Minor groups of explicit normalization/definition/model corrections. Several foundational matrix formulas verified.
limitations: P1 — The asserted local Riemannian sphere product fails a curvature-rank test — Counterevidence: No claim that all geodesic spheres or the corrected block construction fail; r2 onGr2,4 locally is compatible.
P2 — Third fundamental form omits the dimension factor on averaged mean curvature — Counterevidence: Second form, shape map, averaged mean and Ricci formulas themselves support the corrected result.

P3 — Weyl sign is incompatible with Riemann convention and induces false Bach value — Counterevidence: Printedalgebra follows its faulty definition; correction targets geometric identification, not just arithmetic. CorrectSchouten/Cotton and Einstein property remain.

P4 — Scalar/delta conventions and maximizing basis need consistent normalization — Counterevidence: Attainable extrema0and r/4 forsectional sums are repairable with explicit corrected blocks; not a refutation of the block extremization idea.
P5 — Jacobi expression has an overall factor of two — Counterevidence: Riemann and sectional formulas unchanged.

P6 — Tensor divergence and frame-bundle explanation require correction — Counterevidence: Zero torsion/nonmetricity and verticalcocurvature remainvalid; corrected parallel/divergence properties canstillhold.

P7 — One quotient is the wrong manifold and repeated representative alignment is unnecessary — Counterevidence: Does not deny practical utility of involution model or any measured stabilityadvantage; none measuredhere.
Limitations: Exact acquired published-format PDF only; no other version or later correction was compared.

repair.content:
Replace claimed range with an actually justified product construction; orthogonal4blocks yield globalr<=floor(min(k,n-k)/2). Check mixed curvatures/Lie-triple closure and metric, not only tangent orthogonality.

Use traceII=mH in Gauss contraction; update III=(n+2)g/8=(n+2)tr(X0^TY0)/4.

For paperRie convention use W=Rie+lambda K/(m-1) in Einstein case and corresponding Ricci-decomposition signs; genuine Bach vanishes in allowed dimensions.

Chen convention:upperm(n-2)/16,lowerupper-r/4. Fulltrace consistently onsubspaces:upperm(n-2)/8,lowerupper-r/2. If retaining hybrid quantity label it explicitly. Replace maximizing basis.

Multiply the displayed fullmatrix and block expressions by1/2.

Use covariant contraction, horizontal lifts/pullbackTM and verticalfibers; restrict Schouten/Cotton tom>2 and Bach tom>3 or defineextensionsseparately.

Use block uppertriangular parabolic stabilizer. Specify commonQ and lifts once; compare actual algorithms/metric normalizations.
